title: Raw jobs file
description: data/jobs.raw.json: the collector's output for one run, with a per-company record of what happened.

companies.description: One entry per company the run considered, including those it skipped.

status.description: ok: feed or careers page read, every posting found. error: the request or parse failed. blocked: the host refused us (HTTP 403 or 429, a sign-in page or a bot check); do not retry or work around it. skipped: no reader for this ATS, the company is not collected, or robots.txt disallows its careers page. The rest are for companies read from their own careers page (ats.type 'other'): none-open: the careers page was read and lists no openings. partial: some postings were read but not all (a request cap was hit or posting pages failed); 'error' says what is missing. unreadable: the page lists its postings in a way the reader cannot read (built by JavaScript, PDF only). no-careers-page: no careers page was found on the company's site. ats-found: the careers page links to a job-board system; 'error' names the system and board token so the registry can be updated.
